# Ahmadreza Samadi

> Ahmadreza Samadi is a technology entrepreneur based in Dubai. He builds AI products as Co-Founder & Technical Lead of Appraiva and runs Royal Abraj Group as Co-Founder & CEO.

Also known as Ahmad Samadi. Persian: احمدرضا صمدی; short form احمد صمدی. Arabic: أحمدرضا صمدي.

## Facts — as of October 2026

- Position: “I build AI, and I run a business that has to live with it.” Technology entrepreneur; Co-Founder & Technical Lead of Appraiva and Co-Founder & CEO of Royal Abraj Group.
- Based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates; also known as Ahmad Samadi.
- Co-Founder & Technical Lead of Appraiva since October 2023. Appraiva is based in Cleveland, Ohio, United States; he works remotely from Dubai. It builds AI tools for investors and developers to find distressed and off-market properties through imagery analysis and enriched property data.
- Co-Founder & CEO of Royal Abraj Group since 2022. The Dubai group covers property brokerage and documents-clearing services; he leads digital strategy and technology.
- Background: enterprise data engineering and machine learning; Azure data infrastructure for CRM migration and analytics at Oxfam Novib; predictive customer segmentation at MCI.
- Education: Master of Science in Computer Software Engineering, specialization in Data, Shahid Beheshti University, 2019–2021.
- Contact: ahmadreza.smdi@gmail.com.
- Other people share the name Ahmad Samadi; this is the official site of the Dubai-based technology entrepreneur.

- [Royal Abraj Group in Dubai and Ahmadreza Samadi’s role](https://a-samadi.com/work/royal-abraj.html): Follow how Ahmadreza Samadi connects an enquiry to CRM follow-up and a customer portal at Royal Abraj Group, a Dubai brokerage and documents-clearing business.

- [Hamrah e Aval (MCI)](https://a-samadi.com/work/mci.html): Ahmadreza Samadi’s MCI work used RFM and behavioral data for customer segmentation, churn-risk analysis and campaign targeting, without uplift claims.

## Studies

- [Rent vs owning: 393 metro cash-budget scenarios](https://a-samadi.com/studies/rent-own-2026/): Rent vs owning through hypothetical landlord cash budgets across 393 metros. Compare HUD rent areas, ACS values, costs and limits; not a personal buy-or-rent answer.
- [Property Decision Data](https://a-samadi.com/studies/): Open property studies by Ahmadreza Samadi, with source years, geography, assumptions, methods and practical decision tools.
- [Rent burden in 386 US metros: ACS 2024](https://a-samadi.com/studies/rent-burden/): A reproducible ACS 2024 study of 30% and 50% gross-rent-to-income thresholds, with explicit denominator exclusions and uncertainty limits.

## Writing

- [Start with the decision, then build the AI](https://a-samadi.com/writing/start-with-the-decision.html): A practical approach to AI product decisions: start with the customer’s decision, assess the evidence, and evaluate the whole workflow.
- [AI cost per accepted result](https://a-samadi.com/writing/ai-cost-per-verified-result.html) (article + [film](https://a-samadi.com/watch/business-ai-evaluation-cases.html)): A practical framework for measuring AI workflow cost: include tokens, tools, retries and human review, then divide by results that pass verification.
- [Writing on AI products and business](https://a-samadi.com/writing/): Read Ahmadreza Samadi on building AI products, testing them on real tasks and counting review costs. Explore property examples and everyday technology explainers.
- [AI agent safety policy for accounts, tools and approvals](https://a-samadi.com/writing/ai-agent-safety-boundaries.html): Define which accounts, data and tools an AI agent can access. See where permissions are enforced, when a person approves an action and how to revoke access.
- [AI in real estate decisions: where AI should stop](https://a-samadi.com/writing/ai-human-review-real-estate.html): AI can prepare real estate information; people must verify material claims and explain uncertainty before a client decides. Use an explicit review handoff.
- [How to check an AI home value estimate against sales](https://a-samadi.com/writing/ai-home-value-estimates.html): When two AI estimates disagree on a home's value, start with the facts each used. Review the sale dates, comparable homes and uncertainty before relying on a figure.
- [How does property data enrichment connect the right records?](https://a-samadi.com/writing/property-data-enrichment.html): A fictional image-and-record comparison shows how to check property identity, source dates and unresolved claims before combining property information.
- [Dubai property costs and data: choose the right source](https://a-samadi.com/writing/which-dubai-property-source.html): Choose Dubai property sources by purpose: sale and mortgage fees, rental benchmarks, sales-price indices or a specific valuation. Keep dates and limits visible.
- [AVM vs. appraisal when comparable sales are limited](https://a-samadi.com/writing/avm-vs-appraisal.html): Compare an automated valuation, a broker opinion and an appraisal. See how missing sales, uncertain property condition and the intended use affect the choice.
- [AI evaluations: test the task, not just the demo](https://a-samadi.com/writing/business-ai-evaluation-cases.html) (article + [film](https://a-samadi.com/watch/business-ai-evaluation-cases.html)): Ahmadreza Samadi explains why a polished AI demonstration does not establish reliability for the real task: choose evaluation cases from the work.
- [Building energy audits: diagnose before replacing](https://a-samadi.com/writing/building-energy-audit-decisions.html) (article + [film](https://a-samadi.com/watch/building-energy-audit-decisions.html)): A fictional building manager investigates a high energy bill. Follow the audit questions about equipment and daily operation before deciding what to replace.
- [More AI agents can expose a shared bottleneck](https://a-samadi.com/writing/agent-workflow-shared-bottlenecks.html) (article + [film](https://a-samadi.com/watch/agent-workflow-shared-bottlenecks.html)): In a fictional dispatch library, every helper needs the same key. Follow the queue to see which tasks an extra agent can take on and which still have to wait.

## Tools

- [Before You Build the AI](https://a-samadi.com/tools/before-you-build-ai.html): Turn an AI idea into a decision, an evidence plan and a small first experiment. A free interactive field guide by Ahmadreza Samadi.
- [Rental cash flow calculator](https://a-samadi.com/tools/rental-cash-flow.html): Separate annual rent, property costs, debt cash payments and upfront invested cash using your own AED inputs. Blank values remain unknown.
- [Dubai property purchase costs and buyer fee calculator](https://a-samadi.com/tools/dubai-purchase-cost.html): Estimate the fees a buyer pays on a completed residential property in Dubai. Enter your quotes and payer shares to see how much each cost adds to the purchase.
- [Valuation range checker](https://a-samadi.com/tools/valuation-range.html): Compare two to five property estimates: median, range, spread and transparent review flags. Your inputs stay in your browser.
- [Dubai rental yield calculator for gross and net income](https://a-samadi.com/tools/dubai-rental-yield.html): Calculate gross and net rental yield for a Dubai property using your own rent, vacancy and expenses. See how service charges change the income you keep.

## Explainers

- [What a Gemini business hub can do](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/tech-trend-gemini-business-hub.html): Google announced a Gemini landing page for small businesses, with brand, finance and connected-app tools. Start with the workflow you need.
- [An AI factory needs more than GPUs.](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/tech-trend-ai-factory-observability.html): NVIDIA announced Minerva, an AIOps platform connecting infrastructure and workload signals. The trend is visibility across the whole operation.
- [World models and real-world tests](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/tech-trend-world-models-real-tests.html): NVIDIA expanded Cosmos with data, training and simulation tools for physical AI. Generated scenarios can broaden what developers test.
- [A chat request is not a shipped fix.](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/tech-trend-notification-to-reviewed-fix.html): GitHub announced a consolidated Teams app that connects issue notifications with Copilot. The review step still belongs in the workflow.
- [How to check a Dubai broker record](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/dubai-broker-record-check.html): Follow a Dubai broker record check through the official listing. See which details identify the broker and which property and transaction facts need separate checks.
- [Dubai project status and registration](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/dubai-project-status-check.html): Match a Dubai project to its registered record before reading a progress update. Use the slides to check that the evidence describes the same project.
- [Dubai rental index and asking rents](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/dubai-rental-index-context.html): Compare a Dubai asking rent with an official rental index result. Keep the property details, advertised price and index evidence distinct as you read each slide.
- [Dubai procedure status: check the actual result](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/dubai-procedure-status-check.html): Read a Dubai procedure status in context. Follow the slides to distinguish what the record currently shows from the outcome someone expects to happen next.
- [Dubai valuation: identify the evidence behind the number](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/dubai-valuation-evidence.html): Compare property valuation evidence in Dubai. Identify the type of value, its source and the purpose of the comparison before relying on a figure for a decision.
- [AI property briefs: keep claims tied to evidence](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/ai-property-brief-evidence.html): Review an AI-generated property brief slide by slide. Trace each important claim to its source, identify missing evidence and decide what still needs checking.
